mapper.select: SELECT D.*, P.NAME AS PRODUCT_NAME, P.DESCRIPTION AS PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION, P.PRICE AS ORIGINAL_PRICE, ((P.PRICE * (100 - D.DISCOUNT_VALUE)) / 100) AS DISCOUNTED_PRICE, PF.FILE_PATH AS productFilePath FROM DISCOUNT_TB D JOIN DISCOUNT_TARGET_TB DT ON D.ID = DT.DISCOUNT_ID JOIN PRODUCT_TB P ON DT.TARGET_ID = P.PRODUCT_NUMBER JOIN PRODUCT_FILE_TB PF ON P.PRODUCT_NUMBER = PF.PRODUCT_NUMBER WHERE DT.TARGET_TYPE = 'PRODUCT' AND SYSDATE BETWEEN D.START_DATE AND D.END_DATE
